integrity: The result is an exact algebraic consequence of the published threshold formula. The general proof uses symbolic factorization, differentiation and a quadratic boundary equation; the included finite rational checks are only reproducibility aids. Literature comparisons distinguish different models and do not treat failed search as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the source model's exact local reinfection threshold at \(R_0=1\) while varying the constant vaccination rate with all other listed parameters fixed. It does not determine the lower critical reproduction number, endemic prevalence, basin size, or global dynamics as functions of vaccination rate.
title: A sharp vaccination-rate window for reinfection-driven backward bifurcation
